title: Disney Mickey Mouse & Pluto Christmas Ornament 1999 - Used
categoryName: Collectibles:Disneyana:Contemporary (1968-Now):Pins, Patches & Buttons:Other Disney Pins & Patches
descriptionText: The Disney Ornament Mickey Mouse A Christmas To Remember 1999 is a collectible item featuring the iconic character Mickey Mouse from the Disney franchise. This ornament captures the theme of Christmas and is a special edition from the year 1999, making it a unique and cherished addition to any Disneyana collection. Perfect for fans of Disney and collectors of pins, patches, and buttons, this ornament is a delightful and nostalgic reminder of a beloved holiday season.
